title: Rosemary Beach 25 S. Belize Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located South of 30A- Steps from the Coquina Pool- Access to 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- Professionally decorated- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: 25 S. Belize Lane is a gorgeous 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach home that enjoys views of the famous Coquina Pool and boardwalk access to the beach. Guests will love being south of 30A with easy access to the beach, the Rosemary Beach Racquet Club, restaurants, and shopping. An open living, dining, and kitchen area welcomes guests to the home. Hardwood floors, comfortable furnishings, and a cozy window seat create a warm, welcoming environment for a beach escape. Premium appliances and white cabinetry surround a marble-topped island with a gas cooktop and seating for 4. A dining table, sofas, and armchairs enjoy natural light from multiple sets of French doors that open to a covered porch. A guest bedroom with a queen bed has a private bathroom with a shower and French doors that also open to the covered porch, which runs the length of the house. Guests can enjoy lovely views of palmetto and scrub oak while cooling off after a hot day. At the top of the stairs on the second floor is a colorful living area with a wrap-around sofa, flat-screen TV, and French doors opening to a balcony. A guest bedroom has a queen bed, a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo, and French doors which open to the balcony. A primary bedroom has a king bed, 2 sets of French doors opening to the balcony, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Guests will love the view of Rosemary Beach’s most iconic pool—the Coquina Pool—from the balcony and those warm salt-air breezes. Younger guests will have a blast playing and sleeping on the third floor. This expansive living and sleeping area has 3 built-in twin beds with twin trundles, a sofa, and a flat-screen TV. With this fantastic location and these features, 25 S. Belize Lane will book quickly. Guests can easily explore Rosemary Beach and nearby 30A communities on 4 included adult bikes. Book your next luxurious escape today.
